text: Erin Bruner, an ambitious agnostic lawyer chasing a partnership, defends Father Richard Moore, a Catholic priest charged with negligent homicide after the failed exorcism of 19-year-old student Emily Rose. In court, flashbacks trace Emily's [delusions and muscle spasms at 3 a.m.|threat|being taken over] and the doctors who call it epilepsy and psychosis. Soon Bruner herself [wakes at 3 a.m. to the smell of burning|who_suffers|those who step in], a key witness is killed by a car, and [a letter Emily wrote before her death|images|books, letters and writing] tells of a choice she made in a field.
